configurations.name: no-api
runtimeArgs: PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"; S="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ff-noapi-state"; rm -rf "$S"; cp -R fixtures "$S"; rm -f "$S"/yahoo-sync.json "$S"/yahoo-leagues.json "$S"/yahoo-oauth.json; STATE_DIR="$S" PORT=4602 exec npx tsx src/server/index.ts

configurations.name: nba-test
runtimeArgs: PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"; S="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ff-nba-test-state"; rm -rf "$S"; mkdir -p "$S"; node -e "const l=require('./data/nba/leagues.json').leagues.map(x=>({...x,id:x.id+'-test',label:x.label+' (test)'}));require('fs').writeFileSync(process.argv[1]+'/nba-leagues.local.json',JSON.stringify({leagues:l}))" "$S"; NBA_NOW="${NBA_NOW:-2026-11-18T23:30:00Z}" STATE_DIR="$S" PORT=4603 exec npx tsx src/server/index.ts

runtimeArgs: PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"; S="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ff-nba-test-live-state"; rm -rf "$S"; mkdir -p "$S"; node -e "const l=require('./data/nba/leagues.json').leagues.map(x=>({...x,id:x.id+'-test',label:x.label+' (test)'}));require('fs').writeFileSync(process.argv[1]+'/nba-leagues.local.json',JSON.stringify({leagues:l}))" "$S"; NBA_NOW="2026-11-19T01:45:00Z" STATE_DIR="$S" PORT=4604 exec npx tsx src/server/index.ts
